parsed.note_claim: She was charged with criminal mischief for getting into the back of a police cruiser with its emergency lights activated during a traffic stop without permission and asking for a ride to the bar.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The emergency lights on the police vehicle were activated. When the officer returned to his patrol vehicle, he looked over his shoulder and saw a woman in the backseat of the cruiser... asked the police officer if he would give her a ride to a bar... She was cited for criminal mischief.
parsed.reason: The page directly describes the woman getting into a police cruiser with emergency lights activated during a traffic stop, asking for a ride to a bar, and being cited for criminal mischief, substantiating the note's claim.
